cases.name: Two more years, answered rather than interrogated
cases.gap: Turns 1 and 3 pass after Phase 2a: "work two more years" now produces a variant at $36,567.41 on 23.2 years of service, and the answer leads with it. Turn 2 is what remains. "Assume I get a 3% raise each year" names no age and no offset, so `corroborated` will not carry turn 1's scenario forward, and `recompute` looks for a revised fact the worksheet holds -- a growth rule is not one. The machinery works when the rule arrives with the horizon: "if I work two more years assuming a 3% raise each year" returns years_from_now 2 with salary_growth 0.03, verified live. What is missing is a rule stated in a later turn than the scenario it modifies, which is conversational state the pipeline does not keep (Phase 3).
